title: 1995 Manual Of The Planes 45 Jeff Easley FPG Fantasy Art Trading Card TCG
descriptionText: The product is a 1995 FPG fantasy art trading card from the Jeff Easley franchise. This non-sport trading card features the "Manual Of The Planes" and is card number 45 in the series. It likely holds value for collectors interested in fantasy-themed trading cards from the mid-90s, showcasing the unique artwork and lore created by Jeff Easley for this franchise.
